carrier_definition.reason: This is the carrier on which the symmetrized Berry-Keating operator has the stated form -i(x d/dx + 1/2). Under t=log x it is unitarily equivalent to L^2(R, dt).

operator_definition.name: H_xp
operator_definition.log_model: U H_xp U^{-1} = -i d/dt on L^2(R,dt)
operator_definition.spectrum: purely absolutely continuous spectrum R; no point spectrum

self_adjoint_extension_family.full_half_line: The closure of H_xp on L^2(R_+,dx) is self-adjoint; deficiency indices (0,0); no one-parameter extension family.
self_adjoint_extension_family.finite_log_interval_variant: For t in [a,b], -i d/dt has U(1) extensions g(b)=exp(i theta)g(a), theta in [0,2pi), with arithmetic eigenvalues (2*pi*n+theta)/(b-a).
self_adjoint_extension_family.status: finite-box extensions have arithmetic spectra and are not the zeta zero ledger; exact BK modifications require extra non-inherited boundary/cutoff data
